q: Do India's battery waste rules affect a battery maker's carbon reporting?
title: Battery waste rules and carbon data
short: Not directly. The Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 set extended producer responsibility for collection and recycling, and a phased minimum use of recycled material in new batteries. Those records help your carbon work: recycled content changes material emissions, and recycler data feeds end-of-life figures.
audience: Battery producers, importers and recyclers in India

ul: EPR certificates show what was recycled and by whom.
Recycled content per battery feeds your product footprint.
Recycler energy data can support end-of-life emissions.

p: EPR compliance is reported on the CPCB portal; carbon figures follow the GHG Protocol. One does not substitute for the other.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
